text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a progressively increasing swelling on the nape of his neck for 2 months. He denies having a fever, pain, or any discharge from the swelling. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Metastatic colon cancer to the cervical lymph nodes (metastatic neck mass).
